messages:
maria: Taking the nightwatch. I'm primary until 01:20 UTC; aj will be secondary. Quick FYI — I see an uptick in 5xxs against the hosted text-generation endpoint (redwood-3b). Incident-bot just fired a latency+error page. I'm going to do an initial triage, watch traffic, and follow the "runbook:latency" steps. If this becomes customer impacting (>5% of requests failing or >3 high-sev customers affected) we should escalate to eng-lead and SRE.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate on service=redwood-api region=us-west-2 model=redwood-3b - error_rate=7.2% (5m), latency_p50=220ms, latency_p95=940ms. Pager: eng-oncall-primary. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency

aj: ack. What's the current mitigation plan? Any hot restarts or traffic routing you're comfortable doing during nightwatch?

maria: short plan: 1) identify if this is node /model specific or config drift 2) roll traffic to redwood-2b variant (compat fallback) 3) restart inference pods on affected nodes if node-local errors. Initial checks: 
- error heatmap points to inferencer-3a and inferencer-3b
- deployment versions match (v1.4.2)
- KV cache hit drops in same window

If we hit persistent >10% errors after traffic shift, escalate.

sam: If you're going to shift traffic, follow the zero-downtime route-change in runbook. I'll stand by to do pod restarts if traffic shift doesn't reduce errors in 5m. Pager escalation path:
- escalate to oncall-eng-lead (kevin) after 10m continuing high error rate OR any confirmed customer-impacting drop
- page infra-sre if host-level OOMs or container restarts >3 in 2m

maria: doing the traffic fallback now. Using the console quick-change (safer) — command for reference:
```
# console api example
POST /v1/routing/change
{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-2b","percent":100}
```
Applying at 2319876620.

incident-bot: ACTION: routing change applied by maria at 2319876620 — /v1/generate -> redwood-2b (100%). New error_rate=5.1% (2m)

aj: logs show error spikes on inferencer-3a still. I'm tailing logs: `kubectl logs -f inferencer-3a -n inference` — seeing repeated model-load timeouts. Pushing a restart would be my next step if errors don't drop below 2%.

maria: good catch. Sam — want me to hit the restart step now or wait 5 more minutes to see routing effect? Also note: I have a coverage gap 01:30-02:00 UTC (short nap window). Plan to handoff to aj at 01:20 UTC for that window; I'll warm-handoff 10 min before.

sam: wait 3m, looks like error rate trending down but slow. If at 2319876920 it's still >3%, go ahead and restart inferencer-3a. Use this safe restart command from runbook:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inferencer-3a -n inference
# verify pods ReadyCount == expected
```

maria: will restart if no improvement by 2319876920. Reminder for escalation message template when paging eng-lead (kevin): include short customer-impact summary, last 5m error %, top 3 affected customers (if any), and mitigation attempts. Example pager body:
```
SUBJECT: PROD: High 5xx on hosted text-gen (redwood-3b -> fallback redwood-2b)
SUMMARY: 5xx rate 7.2% -> 5.1% after routing fallback. Affecting hosted API in us-west-2. Potentially impacting invoice generation for a few customers.
IMPACT: ~7% requests failing (5m). Observed session drops for customer: acme-co, zephyr-app, quickshop
ACTIONS TAKEN: traffic fallback to redwood-2b (2319876620), monitoring + planned pod restart for inferencer-3a at 2319876920 if errors persist.
REQUEST: help triage infra/model root cause, advise on rollback or further mitigations.
PAGE: @kevin (eng-lead), @infra-sre
```

kevin: looks good. Also include link to the quick log query and customers list (https://redwood.internal/ops/customer-impact?since=5m). If you page me after 10m, I can pull billing traces and coordinate a customer comms draft. If this becomes a cross-region issue escalate immediately to multi-region oncall.

incident-bot: NOTE: routing change observed; watch period starts (10m). If error_rate >5% for next 10m, auto-escalate to eng-lead per policy.

aj: ack, I'm ready to take the handoff at 01:20 UTC. I'll watch logs and be prepared to restart inferencer-3a at 2319876920 if needed. tagging: @maria please drop any last context before you step off.

maria: thanks — last notes: no config changes this deploy, model binary checksum matches, KV cache eviction spike correlated with errors. I'll start the warm-handoff at 01:10 UTC in this thread and DM aj any ephemeral credentials. If I don't respond after 01:25 UTC, treat aj as primary and escalate per the template above.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION CHECK (2319877123): error_rate 1.8% (5m), routing remains on redwood-2b, no page to eng-lead required. Monitoring to continue. If new spike occurs, open new thread.

kevin: thanks for the run — good handoff. Add a short blurb to the postmortem if this reappears (root cause suspicion: cache eviction + model load contention).
